page_title: ESP 1-1 RSO | Espanyol v Real Sociedad 23/05/2026, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+6' Jose Munuera is looking at his watch and immediately ends this match.
90+2' The referee and one of his assistants signal for a corner kick to Real Sociedad.
90' 5 additional min. will be played.
90' Substitution. Carlos Soler leaves the pitch and is replaced by Inaki Ruperez (Real Sociedad).
87' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Leandro Cabrera (Espanyol) was quite harsh and Jose Munuera didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
87' Real Sociedad are ruled offside.
85' Tyrhys Dolan (Espanyol) swings a cross into the box, but it's far too close to Unai Marrero, who smothers the ball.
84' Real Sociedad can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.
84' Real Sociedad take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence. The ball goes out of play and Real Sociedad have been awarded a corner kick.
82' The corner is swung in but Real Sociedad can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.
79' The manager has decided to make a substitution and Ruben Sanchez walks off the pitch to be replaced by Omar El Hilali (Espanyol).
78' Espanyol failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.
77' Today's match ends for Orri Oskarsson who will be replaced by Mikel Oyarzabal (Real Sociedad).
77' Pellegrino Matarazzo has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Aritz Elustondo (Real Sociedad) replacing Jon Aramburu.
76' The referee blows his whistle and players are going to refresh themselves.
72' Substitution. Lluc Castell (Espanyol) has come on for Jofre.
71' Jon Aramburu (Real Sociedad) produces a quality cross into the box, but the opposition's defence intercepts the ball and spanks it away.
68' Job Ochieng will be replaced by Pablo Marin (Real Sociedad).
68' Pellegrino Matarazzo decides to make a substitution. Sergio Gomez will be replaced by Aihen Munoz (Real Sociedad).
67' That's the end of the game for Roberto Fernandez Jaen, who is replaced by Kike Garcia (Espanyol).

65' 1 - 1 Goal! Pere Milla displays great vision and sends a pass to Roberto Fernandez Jaen (Espanyol), who shows brilliant composure inside the box to bury the ball into the top right corner. The score is 1:1.
64' Unai Marrero (Real Sociedad) is cautioned and receives a yellow card.
64' Espanyol quickly take a corner kick with a short pass.
62' Jofre (Espanyol) runs onto a loose pass inside the box and releases a tremendous shot towards the roof of the net. However, Unai Marrero anticipates the shot and makes a brilliant save.
61' The resulting set piece from Espanyol is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.
56' Celebrations are cut short for Espanyol as the referee indicates NO GOAL after the VAR review due to a foul in the build-up play.
55' The Espanyol players halt their celebrations as referee Jose Munuera makes the VAR signal to review the goal, most likely to ascertain if there was a foul in the build-up play.
54' Tyrhys Dolan (Espanyol) receives a brilliant pass inside the box from Jofre, and he beats the goalkeeper with a low accurate shot into the middle of the goal. He makes it 1:1.
49' Jose Munuera has a clear sight and sees a foul from Carlos Soler (Real Sociedad).

47' Pere Milla (Espanyol) picks up the rebound inside the penalty area and releases a good shot to the middle of the goal. Unfortunately for him, Unai Marrero shows how quick his reflexes are and dives superbly to stop his effort. What a save but what a wasted opportunity!
47' The attendance is 28012.
46' Here is a change after the half-time break. Antoniu Roca (Espanyol) is replaced by Pere Milla.
46' The game is over for Ramon Terrats (Espanyol). Tyrhys Dolan comes on for the second half.
46' The second half has just started.
45+4' Jose Munuera has ended the first half by blowing the whistle.
45+2' Jofre (Espanyol) tries to send a pass but it's blocked.
45' The fourth official shows 3 min. of added time.
43' Luka Sucic (Real Sociedad) makes a reckless foul in order to win the ball from his opponent. Jose Munuera has a clear sight of it and blows his whistle.
40' Dangerous play by Antoniu Roca (Espanyol). Jose Munuera blows his whistle for a foul.
38' Jofre (Espanyol) fails to find any of his teammates inside the box as his pass is blocked.
36' Luken Beitia (Real Sociedad) requires medical treatment, so the referee stops play and signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
35' Espanyol couldn't find the way to score from a mid-range free kick as Unai Marrero (Real Sociedad) leaped high and intercepted the cross.
33' A pass from Orri Oskarsson (Real Sociedad) is intercepted by Angel Fortuno and the move breaks down.
31' It’s hot out there so the ref signals there will be a cooling break for the players to take on some fluids.
28' 0 - 1 Orri Oskarsson (Real Sociedad) finds himself in a great position after receiving a precise pass inside the box and sends the ball beyond the goalkeeper, off the crossbar.
25' Jose Munuera interrupts the game. One of the players from Espanyol won the ball, but his effort is adjudged unfair.
23' Jose Munuera shows a yellow card to Yangel Herrera (Real Sociedad) for his blatant foul.
21' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Real Sociedad.

21' Angel Fortuno was forced into action to thwart Orri Oskarsson (Real Sociedad). He found himself some space after latching on to a pass and unleashed a shot to the bottom left corner but couldn't beat the keeper. Real Sociedad have been awarded a corner kick.
20' Flag goes up against Job Ochieng (Real Sociedad) and the referee blows his whistle for offside.
16' The referee blows his whistle as Igor Zubeldia (Real Sociedad) was too aggressive in his challenge.
14' One of the Real Sociedad players is in on goal but gets upended by the defender in the box. That could be a penalty, but the ref says NO! Play continues.
12' Sergio Gomez (Real Sociedad) produces a lovely ball into the penalty area but the defender manages to intercept and comfortably averts the danger.

10' Ramon Terrats (Espanyol) wastes a big opportunity. He shoots from the free kick just outside the box, but his poor effort goes well over the crossbar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Real Sociedad.
10' A free kick is awarded to Espanyol.
9' Sergio Gomez (Real Sociedad) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Jose Munuera had an easy-decision to make.
9' The attendance for today's match is 28012.

6' Carlos Romero (Espanyol) produced a promising shot low towards the middle of the goal after his wonderful solo run, but Unai Marrero thwarted him with a fabulous save and the score remains the same.
4' The Real Sociedad players keep the ball and are exchanging a combination of passes. They are waiting for gaps in the defence to open up.
1' The first half has just begun.
The players are on the pitch and Real Sociedad will have the kick-off.
Jose Munuera was nominated as the referee for this game.
